buckets.people: Photos whose main subject is one or more people: selfies, portraits, group shots, family, kids.
buckets.home: Photos of a home: rooms, interiors, furniture, appliances, house exterior, yard, home projects or repairs.
buckets.pets_animals: Photos of pets or any other animals.
buckets.food: Photos of food, drinks, meals, restaurant dishes, groceries or cooking.
buckets.nature: Outdoor nature: landscapes, mountains, beaches, forests, plants, flowers, sky, sunsets.
buckets.travel_places: Places visited: cities, streets, landmarks, buildings, attractions, airports, hotels, vehicles while traveling.
buckets.documents_receipts: Camera photos (not screenshots) of paper documents, receipts, bills, forms, IDs, whiteboards or signs.
buckets.screenshot_code: Screenshots of source code, terminals, IDEs, logs or developer tools.
buckets.screenshot_chat: Screenshots of chats, text messages, email or social-media conversations.
buckets.screenshot_finance_charts: Screenshots of stock/crypto charts, trading or brokerage apps, bank accounts or financial dashboards.
buckets.screenshot_other: Any other screenshot of a phone or computer screen: apps, websites, settings, maps, order confirmations.
buckets.memes: Memes, jokes or images with overlaid humorous captions, including screenshots shared as memes.
buckets.other: Anything that fits none of the other buckets.
